purpose: Teach: 激突/宝庫/博し/中澤/中尾/江原/大原/大川

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、車両激突事故の重症患者対応を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be handling the severe motor vehicle collision patients as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, clinical opening. Steady professional tone. Even pacing, no hesitation. Direct eye contact level. The tone of someone briefing, not warning.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療資料の宝庫、つまり病院アーカイブを医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, the hospital archive—our medical resource repository—we'll maintain it collectively as a team.
lines.style: Same measured clarity. Slight pause before the clarification, as if thinking aloud. Deliberate, careful with the important details. Still warm underneath the clinical language.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地域で人気を博した診療所のモデル研究を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be conducting a model study of the clinic's approach in our community as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady rhythm continues. Slight emphasis on 'model study'—this matters. No performance, just competent information transfer. Breath control even and controlled.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者中澤様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue monitoring patient Nakasawa's condition as a team.
lines.style: Brief, direct. Respectful use of the patient's name. No extra weight—just stating the fact. Consistent professional tone throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者中尾様のリハビリを医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be supporting patient Nakao's rehabilitation as a medical team.
lines.style: Same steady delivery. Slight warmth on 'supporting'—indicates care, not just procedure. Even pace, no trailing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者江原様の精神科ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be providing psychiatric care for patient Ehara as a team.
lines.style: No change in register—psychiatric care stated with the same clinical respect as physical care. Steady, matter-of-fact. Dignified.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者大原様の終末期ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be providing end-of-life care for patient Ohara as a medical team.
lines.style: Tone deepens slightly—weight of the moment acknowledged without wavering. Still composed. Respectful pause before the patient's name. Steady, not rushed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医師大川先生のご助言を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be valuing Dr. Okawa's medical guidance within our team.
lines.style: Final note: slight warmth returns. Closing thought. Respectful of hierarchy without deference. Breath gentles at the end, like a small closing.
